name: Clipboard Popup
description: A compact clipboard history popup near your pointer or supported text cursor. Plain text and PNG images, search, favorites, previews, private mode, application exclusions, and optional paste-on-select. Assign Super+V in preferences for Win+V-style access; shortcuts are opt-in. Clipboard access: reads clipboard and optionally primary-selection contents to build local history, writes selected entries to the clipboard, and optionally simulates a paste keypress. Password-manager hints are always respected. No network access or separate daemon.
